issues.title: Handle time to repair, plus repair
issues.body:
We need the concept of repairable damaged assets in the game.

For this, in adjudication umpires will indicate the condition (health) of an asset, plus how many days to repair an it - if it is repairable.  The `Days to repair` drop-down will contain `n/a` (not repairable, default), or a number of days: `1`, `2`, `3`.

Serge will calculate when the repairs will be complete, and store this in "a_Repair_Complete" date-time attribute for that asset. 

While handling adjudication outcomes SERGE will interrupt the process to see if any assets should have been repaired by the time of the end of the interaction.  If any should have been repaired by this time, a special "health" outcome will be injected to the adjudication.  As the outcomes are then formally processed, the health outcome will be handled by restoring the asset to 100% health, and the `a_Repair_Complete` attribute will be removed.

Separate to that process, if an adjudication outcome for an asset gives a new time to repair, then the `a_Repair_Complete` date will be updated to the new date.  Alternatively, if a new `health` outcome for that asset is `n/a` then the `a_Repair_Complete` value will be cleared.
